description: This file is a JavaScript source file implementing an API client for NetWeb Device Management in a React project. It provides functions to make GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE HTTP requests using fetch, with error handling and environment-based configuration.

methods.name: requireBaseUrl()
methods.description: Checks if the REACT_APP_API_BASE_URL environment variable is set, throws an error if not.

methods.name: parseError(response)
methods.description: Processes an HTTP response to extract a user-friendly error message, attempting JSON parsing first, with fallback to text or status.

methods.name: apiGet(path, { query } = {})
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified API path with optional query parameters, returning parsed JSON data.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Performs a POST request with a JSON body to the specified API path, returning the response parsed as JSON.

methods.name: apiPut(path, body)
methods.description: Performs a PUT request with a JSON body to the specified API path, returning the response parsed as JSON.

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Performs a DELETE request to the specified API path, returning true if successful.
